criteria: linked active Core customer and valid address when delivery is required
every item maps to canonical SKU and unit
status and source timestamps are consistent
no retry duplicate or conflicting source reference
classes.action: eligible for separately rehearsed migration; not automatically migrated

criteria: records field demand or request but lacks one or more official-order requirements
classes.action: retain in MCP as intent/request and optionally recreate through canonical Core API after approval

criteria: purpose is sample, trial, product test or evaluation rather than commercial order
classes.action: retain in MCP test/sample lifecycle; never migrate as official Sales Order

criteria: record is meaningful for history but cannot or should not create current operational obligations

classes.action: quarantine from migration and require manual reconciliation
